newsitem.title: ITALY: Three Albanian patrol boats desert to Italy.
newsitem.headline: Three Albanian patrol boats desert to Italy.

text.p: The crews of three Albanian military patrol boats deserted and handed themselves over to the Italian navy in international waters on Thursday, Ansa news agency reported.
The boats were heading toward the southern Adriatic port of Brindisi, it said, although there was no immediate idea of how many people were involved.
A merchant ship that had been seized in the port of Durres with scores of Albanians on board was also heading for Brindisi under an Italian navy escort, coastguards said.
Last week, an Albanian military plane landed in southern Italy and its two pilots asked for political asylum.
Albania was sliding closer to anarchy on Thursday as arms depots in several towns including the capital Tirana were looted and food warehouses raided.
